name: Reactions
description: Rules that move Workflow statuses after a change commits: when the instance's status enters a state, or when every instance that links to it through a link is in a terminal state, move the instance, or the instance one of its links points to, to a state. An engine runs them after the commit, as the principal it names for its runner, so a rule never refuses the change that set it off. A target already in the state, with no transition to it, or whose guards refuse is left as it is.

rules.description: The rules, each one when and one then, in the order they run.

then.description: What the rule does: move the instance, or the instance its link points to, to a state through Workflow's transition.

link.description: A link of the type's Links config: the target is the instance it points to. The instance itself when absent.

transition.description: The state to move the target to.

when.description: What sets the rule off: one of enters and allTerminal.

allTerminal.description: The rule fires on an instance when an instance of schema that links to it through link changes or goes, and every instance that links to it there is in a terminal state of its own schema's Workflow, at least one.

link.description: The link of that schema's Links config that points at this type's schema.

schema.description: The schema of the linking instances, which composes Links and Workflow.

enters.description: A state of the type's Workflow: the rule fires when the instance's status becomes it, by a create or a transition.
